_comment: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B image-to-video. Uses the Q5 diffusion model with ComfyUI's native FP8-scaled UMT5 encoder and the official 20-step sampler. A controlled 2026-07-29 A/B found this encoder at 832x480/121 frames produced 0s freeze and passed motion/speed/corruption gates; the old Q4 encoder plus 1024x576 production path repeatedly collapsed into static clips. Placeholders {image} {prompt} {width} {height} {frames} {seed} are substituted by plugins/comfyui/plugin.py::_generate_video.
_requires: ComfyUI-GGUF (UnetLoaderGGUF) + ComfyUI core CLIPLoader + ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite (VHS_VideoCombine). Models: unet/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Q5_K_M.gguf, text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp8_e4m3fn_scaled.safetensors, vae/Wan2_2_VAE_bf16.safetensors.
_constraints: Wan22ImageToVideoLatent: width/height are multiples of 32; length is on a 4n+1 grid (NOT LTX's 8n+1). Native frame rate is 24fps, so 121 frames = 5.0s. start_image is resized internally, no ImageScale node needed.

inputs.text: {negative_prompt}, blurry, low quality, distorted, worst quality, ugly, static image, no motion, watermark, text, oversaturated, jpeg artifacts, deformed, color bars, colored border, chromatic frame edge, edge artifacts
